skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of Marxist philosophy including dialectical materialism and historical materialism.
Analyze political ideologies and their impact on society using Marxist theory.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate arguments and theories within the context of Marxist philosophy.
Apply historical analysis techniques to understand the development of Marxist ideology over time.
Examine social theories derived from Marxist philosophy and their application to contemporary issues.
